method.note: 2025 RUS awards model built from the fall 2025 Deseret school-year archive, RUS 2025 team records and no estimated missing stats. All-State, All-Region, All-Utah and All-Rural position teams use the shared position formulas (2026-08-31-v9). Every tracked offensive award player (QB/RB/WR/TE/ATH) receives credit for all reported passing + rushing + receiving production, including trick-play and multi-role stats; defensive stats are excluded from those offensive-position scores, and run-first QBs receive enhanced rushing credit. Final team displays exclude a Player of the Year from that same First/Second Team and use the remaining ranked players for honorable mention.
